sources.name: e-Business Register (Äriregister, RIK)
sources.verdict: Official national commercial register run by RIK. Free public search of all Estonian legal entities incl. beneficial owners and annual reports. Verified indirectly via its open-data portal.

sources.name: e-Business Register Open Data portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Fully open bulk downloads (machine-readable, CC BY 4.0) plus open-data API endpoints: company status/details, annual reports, beneficial owners, entries and rulings. The single best bulk backbone for EE entities — genuinely free, no auth for bulk files.

sources.name: e-Business Register APIs (REST + X-Road)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (listed on open-data portal). REST API and X-Road REST for beneficial-owner and company queries; some detailed XML services are contract/paid.

sources.name: EMTA open data — paid taxes, turnover, employees per company
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Tax and Customs Board publishes quarterly XLSX/CSV of paid taxes, turnover and employee counts for every registered business (10th day after quarter). Registry-grade financial signal for AUM proxies, servicer/NPL activity, portfolio company health.

sources.name: e-Land Register (e-Kinnistusraamat)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official property register (owners, mortgages, restrictions), Est/Eng interface. Searchable; some detailed queries free only for owners/entitled persons — bulk access is limited, per-query works.

sources.name: Building Register (Ehitisregister, EHR)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED redirect from ehr.ee. Official building register (permits, buildings, energy certificates) — relevant for developers/RE. JS single-page app; data also surfaced via Estonian open-data portal.

sources.name: Finantsinspektsioon — supervised entities register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via fi.ee homepage. Registers of banks, fund managers (incl. AIFMs), investment firms, insurers, creditors, payment institutions, and now MiCA CASPs. Already harvested per hints — extend to CASP and creditor registers.

sources.name: FI central storage of regulated information (OAM)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official storage of issuer regulated announcements and PDMR (manager transaction) notifications. Login is for submitters; disclosure registers are the public record route.

sources.name: FI statistics environment (FIstar)
sources.verdict: Linked from verified FI homepage; not fetched directly. Financial-sector statistics environment (banks, funds, insurers). JS app.

sources.name: Eesti Pank statistics
sources.verdict: Central bank statistics database (credit institutions, funds, financing). Not fetched this session; Eesti Pank main site verified and lists statistical releases incl. crypto asset services.

sources.name: Pensionikeskus — funded pension registry
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Registry/operator of II and III pillar: pension funds, fund managers, fees, NAVs, and a statistics section. The core LP-side dataset for Estonia.

sources.name: FIU (Rahapesu Andmebüroo) — VASP licenses
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Historic licensor of virtual asset service providers; publishes revoked licenses and news. Post-MiCA (transition ended 1 Jul 2026 per FI news) CASP supervision sits with Finantsinspektsioon — use both.

sources.name: MTR — majandustegevuse register (TTJA)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public unauthenticated search of activity licenses/notifications (incl. historic crypto-provider licenses, debt collection-adjacent activities). NOTE: migrating to the new 'Tarvik' system from 25.06.2025 — track the successor.

sources.name: EU Transaction Log (EUTL) — Estonian ETS accounts
sources.verdict: Not fetched this session but well-established: public EUTL lets you filter Estonian registry accounts, installations and compliance — the public carbon-registry route for EE (national administrator: Environmental Board/Kliimaministeerium).

sources.name: Ametlikud Teadaanded — official announcements
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Fully open official notices portal: bankruptcy, enforcement, liquidation, planning notices. Filterable public search by notice type/registry code, email subscriptions, and an explicit 'data reuse' (Andmete taaskasutamine) route. Primary EE insolvency signal.

sources.name: Riigi Teataja — state gazette
sources.verdict: Fetch returned a JS loading shell; site is authoritative gazette for legal acts and hosts systematic open access (XML of acts). Verified indirectly via kohus.ee which points court publications here.

sources.name: Court decisions search (kohtulahendid, Riigi Teataja)
sources.verdict: Public database of administrative, civil, criminal and misdemeanour decisions — confirmed to exist by kohus.ee (verified), URL itself not fetched this session.

sources.name: Estonian courts (kohus.ee) + public e-File
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Session schedules (published via Riigi Teataja), judicial decisions access, and the Public e-File (etoimik) for case monitoring. Insolvency proceedings themselves surface via Ametlikud Teadaanded.

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic / Nasdaq Tallinn — issuer and share lists
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Baltic Main List, Secondary List and First North with Tallinn-domiciled issuers; XLSX export of share lists. Member lists and bond/fund lists on sibling pages.

sources.name: EstVCA — Estonian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association members
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Full members (VC/PE/mezzanine/family offices), Limited Partners (pension funds, DFIs), associate members (law firms, auditors, banks). ~30+ organizations. Already 'done' per hints — this confirms structure for re-harvest.

sources.name: EstBAN — Estonian Business Angels Network
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Member and fund-member lists, annual investment statistics (EUR 14.1m in 2025), news section.

sources.name: FinanceEstonia — financial sector cluster
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 90+ member directory at /meie-liikmed/ spanning fintech, capital markets, crowdfunding, pensions; news at /uudised/. Good for service-graph and niche-alts entity sourcing.

sources.name: Estonian Banking Association (Pangaliit)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 9 member banks (~98% of sector assets), banking statistics and standards. Leasing association functions folded here historically.

sources.name: Estonian Insurance Association (EKSL)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. 18 member insurers ('all insurance providers operating in Estonia') plus a statistics section — LP-side and ILS-adjacent.

sources.name: EIS — Estonian Business and Innovation Agency (ex-KredEx/Enterprise Estonia)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. National DFI/promotion agency: innovation loans, guarantees, housing finance, export programs; news and newsletter.

sources.name: SmartCap — state fund-of-funds
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Manages Venture Capital Fund (~EUR 176m), Green Fund (EUR 100m), Defence Fund (EUR 100m); public portfolio at /sc_portfolio/ and annual reports. Key EE LP entity + list of backed fund managers.

sources.name: Invest Estonia
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. FDI promotion arm of EIS; sector guides and news; site itself advertises RSS at /feed/ (feed URL not separately fetched).

sources.name: Startup Estonia
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Quarterly sector reports, funding statistics, ecosystem news. Its startup database is powered by Dealroom — per project rules DO NOT scrape the database; use the quarterly reports and go to primary sources instead.

sources.name: Riigihanked — public procurement register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED to exist (JS SPA; content not parseable by plain fetch). Public search of tenders/contracts; procurement datasets also republished on the national open-data portal (avaandmed.eesti.ee) and EU TED.

sources.name: Estonian Bar Association — attorney & law firm search
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via homepage nav: 'Leia advokaat' at /et/vajad-advokaati/eesti-advokaadid and law firms at /et/vajad-advokaati/eesti-advokaadiburood. Service-graph (fund-structuring/M&A law firms).

sources.name: Chamber of Bailiffs and Bankruptcy Trustees (KPK)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Searchable rolls of bailiffs (kohtutäiturid) and bankruptcy trustees (pankrotihaldurid) — the EE insolvency-practitioner directory.

sources.name: Chamber of Notaries (Notarite Koda)
sources.verdict: Real organization with a find-a-notary directory; not fetched this session — verify on ingest.

sources.name: Estonian Chamber of Commerce and Industry
sources.verdict: Real membership directory (~3,000 members) and business news; not fetched this session — verify on ingest.

sources.name: Land and Spatial Development Board (Maaruum, ex-Maa-amet)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (maaamet.ee 302-redirects here — agency renamed). Publishes real-estate transaction statistics, market overviews, State Real Estate Register, and open geodata via Geoportal. Core real-assets pricing source.

sources.name: Kutseregister — professional qualifications register (valuers)
sources.verdict: Register of certified professionals incl. real-estate valuers (kinnisvara hindaja kutse) — the EE equivalent of a valuer roll (RICS has no national EE directory). Not fetched this session — verify URL on ingest.

sources.name: Estonian Association of Appraisers (EKHÜ)
sources.verdict: Real professional body of property valuers; lists certified valuers. Not fetched this session — verify on ingest.

sources.name: Statistics Estonia database (andmed.stat.ee)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED PxWeb statistical database; PxWeb exposes a standard JSON API (API docs not on the landing page but the platform is API-native). Macro/sector context, enterprise demographics.

sources.name: Elering — TSO live data and dashboard
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Electricity/gas TSO with Elering LIVE dashboard, open system data and estfeed data platform — underpins renewables/energy-transition real-asset coverage; also publishes news at /en/articles.

sources.name: ERR News (English)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING RSS. Public broadcaster, English-language; solid economy/business coverage, no paywall. Best free EE English signal.

sources.name: ERR uudised (Estonian, incl. majandus)
sources.verdict: Same verified platform as the English feed; Estonian feed URL follows the same pattern but was not separately fetched — verify on ingest.

sources.name: Äripäev
sources.verdict: THE Estonian business daily (Bonnier). Fetch blocked outright for our client; heavily paywalled. Use headline-level monitoring only, honor paywall — headline+link doctrine. RSS existence unconfirmed (search budget exhausted).

sources.name: Postimees Majandus
sources.verdict: Major daily's business section. Both site and /rss returned 403 to our fetcher (bot protection); /rss is the historically documented feed root — likely works from a normal RSS client. Partially paywalled.

sources.name: Delfi Ärileht
sources.verdict: Business section of Delfi (Ekspress Grupp). Unfetchable by our client (bot protection); Delfi historically exposes RSS per section — feed URL unconfirmed this session.

sources.name: Eesti Ekspress
sources.verdict: Weekly with strong business/investigative coverage (Ekspress Grupp, paywalled). Not fetched this session.

sources.name: The Baltic Times
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. English-language pan-Baltic business/politics coverage since 1996; no visible RSS link on site.

sources.name: ArcticStartup
sources.verdict: Nordic-Baltic startup/VC media covering Estonian rounds. /feed returned 403 to our fetcher (Cloudflare-style block); WordPress feed very likely works from a standard RSS client — verify on ingest.

sources.name: Ärigeenius (geenius.ee business)
sources.verdict: Estonian tech/business portal (Geenius Meedia). Unfetchable by our client; WordPress-network /feed/ is the standard pattern — verify from an RSS client. Partially paywalled.

sources.name: Rahageenius (personal finance/markets, geenius.ee)
sources.verdict: Finance vertical of the same Geenius network; not fetched (sibling site was bot-blocked). Feed URL follows the network pattern — verify on ingest.

sources.name: Finantsinspektsioon news RSS
sources.verdict: VERIFIED WORKING RSS. License grants/withdrawals (Admiral Markets, Crowdestate), CASP transition, merger permissions — high-value entity-event signal.

sources.name: Eesti Pank press releases
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Press releases, economic-policy statements and statistical releases (incl. crypto asset services stats). No RSS link visible — scrape the paginated index.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance (fin.ee) news
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (note: rahandusministeerium.ee is dead — site moved to fin.ee). News on beneficial-ownership rules, Treasury bills, EU funds; footer advertises an RSS feed (exact feed URL not captured — pull from footer on ingest).

sources.name: Nasdaq Baltic market news / issuer disclosures
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official issuer announcements for Baltic regulated market and First North; filterable index plus email newsletter. No RSS link on page; announcements are distributed via GlobeNewswire, whose feed builder is a secondary route.

sources.name: LHV Financial Portal
sources.verdict: LHV bank's market-news portal covering Baltic listed companies — long-running Estonian investor hub. Not fetched this session — verify on ingest.

sources.name: e-Estonia briefing/blog
sources.verdict: Government-backed digital-economy publication; useful for fintech/tokenization context. WordPress feed pattern; not fetched this session.

sources.name: Ehitusuudised (Äripäev construction portal)
sources.verdict: Äripäev-network construction/real-estate trade portal — real-assets deal signal. Not fetched (parent aripaev.ee blocks our client); likely same paywall regime.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strongest startup/VC coverage of Estonia of any global platform — it is the official data partner behind the Startup Estonia database, so Estonian startups, rounds and investor mapping are unusually complete. Weak on private debt, real assets, and the service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: e-Business Register open data (avaandmed.ariregister.rik.ee), EMTA quarterly tax/turnover/employee open data (visible in Estonian startup employment/revenue metrics), press releases and startup media (ArcticStartup, Ärigeenius, ERR), self-reported company profiles, Startup Estonia quarterly reports. All of these are directly accessible to us at source.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Covers the visible Estonian VC/PE layer (BaltCap, Karma Ventures, Trind, Superangel, Specialist VC, Startup Wise Guys, Plural's Estonian footprint) and larger deals; thin below headline rounds, sparse on Estonian LPs, NPL/servicers and niche alts.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company registry filings (ariregister annual reports), Nasdaq Baltic disclosures, EstVCA membership and activity reports, fund/firm press releases, English-language media (ERR News, Baltic Times). Direct routes exist for every one.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Fund-level coverage of Baltic-focused GPs (BaltCap, Livonia, INVL vehicles touching EE) and some LP data via pension-fund reporting; Estonia-specific depth is shallow — few Estonian LPs profiled, almost nothing on service providers.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Finantsinspektsioon fund/AIFM registers, Pensionikeskus fund data, annual reports filed to the e-Business Register, EstVCA publications — all public and directly harvestable.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Estonian startup coverage, largely self-reported and press-derived; unreliable for round completeness and entity resolution (no registry codes).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, TechCrunch/ArcticStartup-type media, self-submission. Registry-linked verification is exactly what they lack and we can add via RIK open data.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Estonian credit-risk and company-intelligence portal: payment defaults, tax arrears, network graphs of boards/owners, distress ratings. Effectively a local moat on registry-derivative analytics; no alternatives-investment framing.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: e-Business Register open data + documents, EMTA open data (tax arrears, paid taxes), Ametlikud Teadaanded insolvency notices, court decisions — 100% public inputs we ingest directly under the same open licenses.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Official credit bureau; company reports, payment-default register (maksehäireregister), scoring. The payment-default ledger itself is proprietary member-contributed data (banks report into it) — not replicable from public sources; everything else is registry-derived.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: e-Business Register, EMTA open data, Ametlikud Teadaanded; proprietary layer is bank-reported defaults.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Company scoring, media-mention monitoring and B2B prospecting on Estonian companies; strong entity-resolution over local media.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: e-Business Register open data, EMTA quarterly data, Estonian online media (Äripäev/Delfi/Postimees headlines), Ametlikud Teadaanded.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free lookup layer over the commercial register incl. beneficial owners and annual-report figures; no analytics. Demonstrates how complete the free RIK data is.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: e-Business Register open data and documents exclusively.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Estonian-founded funding/secondary marketplace; carries data on its own listed private companies and syndicates — a niche primary source for its own deals rather than a coverage competitor.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Own listings and issuer disclosures; underlying entities verifiable via ariregister.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but genuinely absent or consolidated elsewhere: (1) an active privatization/state-asset sales agency — none exists; large-scale privatization ended in the 1990s (Erastamisagentuur dissolved), state holdings are governed via the Ministry of Finance/Ministry of Economic Affairs ownership reports on fin.ee; (2) a standalone leasing/factoring association — Estonian leasing companies are represented within Pangaliit (Banking Association), which carries leasing statistics; (3) an RICS Estonia national directory — RICS has no Estonian chapter directory, only the global find-a-member; the national valuer route is the Kutseregister qualifications register + EKHÜ; (4) a dedicated fund-administrator or depositary licensee list separate from Finantsinspektsioon — fund admins/depositaries appear only inside FI's supervised-entities register; (5) litigation-funding, royalty, or ILS registers — none exist in Estonia; (6) a standalone NPL/servicer register — debt collectors and creditors fall under FI's creditor/credit-intermediary register and (historically) MTR; (7) a separate insolvency court register — insolvency publication is consolidated into Ametlikud Teadaanded, which is why it is the load-bearing tier3 source. Process caveats stated honestly: the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted after two queries, so RSS discovery for Äripäev, Postimees, Delfi and Geenius relied on direct feed-URL fetches, several of which returned 403 bot-blocks — those feeds are marked js-blocked with candidate rssUrls rather than confirmed; rahandusministeerium.ee is dead (moved to fin.ee) and maaamet.ee now redirects to maaruum.ee (agency renamed 2025); MTR is mid-migration to the new Tarvik system (since 25.06.2025) and crypto supervision moved from FIU to Finantsinspektsioon under MiCA (transition ended 01.07.2026) — both successor routes should be tracked at ingest time.
